text:
maria.g: quick follow-up from the quant RFC — i hacked an "observability artifact" payload to help oncall triage fp8/int8/4bit regressions. would love quick sanity check.

samir: looks good. is this emitted per-profile or per model+profile+route?

maria.g: model+profile+route. we need to attribute to a route to find customer regressions.

li: pls use snake_case for fields and include a severity bucket (low/med/high) for dashboards. also add event_id and profile_version.

aj: ops ask: show a compact json example and a prometheus-friendly label set so we can export metrics without parsing blobs.

maria.g: example payload (redacted):
artifact_event: model=redwood-v2-medium; profile_id=fp8-aggressive-2026-03; profile_version=2; route=/chat/generate; event_id=evt-20260308-1; bucket=high; degrade_score=0.82; fidelity_budget=0.12; quality_anchor=qa_v1; anchor_examples=[weather_short]; token_index=18; residual_norm=0.038; kv_mismatch=false; sample_output_snippet="[redacted] less specific"; redaction_flag=true; metadata_ttl_seconds=1209600; sample_ttl_seconds=604800; explainability_collected=false; explainability_uri="gs://..."; collect_cost_ms=0.5; collect_size_bytes=20480

ops-bot: /observe quant-artifacts --since 1h --degrade_score>0.75 --group-by route,model

samir: heavy question — do we collect token-level saliency when degrade_score>0.85? useful but expensive.

maria.g: gated opt-in for canaries/customers. default=false, admin-only retrieval. will add resolution events (rollout_rollback/profile_tweak/false_positive/noop) to close the loop.

aj: make sure sample_output_snippet runs through redaction pipeline and include estimated cost numbers in the doc so product can choose defaults.

maria.g: will open PR with schema (snake_case), console mockups, a small logger shim, runbook for redaction/TTLs, and microbench numbers. tagging reviewers. :pray:
